dataset: Freesound Loop Dataset (Ramires et al., ISMIR 2020)
processing: Dataset PCM WAV bytes are unchanged; only filenames and display labels were adapted. Native playback resamples through the existing sample reader.
selection: 256 different multi-beat loops, each annotated well_cut and defined_tempo by dataset annotators; 4–24 seconds, 44.1 kHz or higher, PCM16 mono/stereo. Silent or highly clipped files, non-loop timing, obvious third-party sample references and duplicate PCM/versioned takes were excluded. This is a technical and metadata review, not an assertion of listening review of every file.

annotation.comments: The loop is timed to be 2 bars of 4/4 at 120, but it doesn't sound like it at all. It's so full of syncopation and off-timing.
